facts.fact: The Namibian reports that the Ministry of ICT launched the national ICT policy at Opuwo, with the minister saying it would guide the ICT sector over the next five years; the launch day is given only as 'Thursday', so the article date is the anchor.
The Namibian reports that the national ICT policy sets out clear roles for the institutions responsible for implementing and monitoring ICT development; no budget line is stated.
The national ICT policy was launched by the ICT minister in January 2026, as reported by The Namibian on 2026-01-29.
